name: Step 2 -- Kill-Switch Whipsaw Fix (EXPERIMENT, not a deliverable)
description: Isolates the effect of buffering + confirming the kill switch's SPY/200-SMA leg (VIX leg untouched). Every other parameter is held fixed at the already-recommended 'confirmed values locked' tuned config from OPTIMIZATION_REPORT.md (cooldown=2, defSell=75, rsiPeriod=24, rsiTrim=50, uproSplit=10) so only the two new params are actually being searched. Lives outside strategies/*.json on purpose -- app/config.py globs that directory for the live dashboard, and this is not a deliverable strategy.

confirmDays.tier_note: Held fixed as in the parent strategy -- never touched by this experiment.

cooldown.tier_note: Fixed at the already-recommended tuned value (2), not re-searched here.

defSell.tier_note: Fixed at the already-recommended tuned value (75), not re-searched here.

rsiPeriod.tier_note: Fixed at the already-recommended tuned value (24), not re-searched here.

rsiTrim.tier_note: Fixed at the already-recommended tuned value (50), not re-searched here.

uproSplit.tier_note: Fixed at the already-recommended tuned value (10), not re-searched here.

killBufferBps.tier_note: NEW. Basis points SPY must close below its 200-SMA (0 = today's bare cross) before the kill switch's SPY leg is even considered. VIX leg untouched. 100bps = 1.0%.

killConfirmDays.tier_note: NEW. Consecutive days the buffered SPY condition must hold before the kill switch's SPY leg fires. 1 = today's single-day trigger (no change).
